title: Each piece starts and ends on a thought
text: Each piece starts where a thought starts and ends where it ends. Read every edge with 2 s of source on each side. An end must finish the sentence, including its closing particle (ครับ / นะ / เลย). A piece that opens on a joining word (เพราะ / แล้วก็ / คือ / แต่) brings the line before it, or moves. The edge must be in a real pause, not just between two engine words.
